subject: Enhance connection handling and UI features
body:
Enhance connection handling and UI features

- Added SuppressCloseNotifications property to InterfaceControl for better connection management.
- Improved RDP connection logic with rapid reconnect handling and enhanced error reporting.
- Introduced methods in ContainerInfo for applying inheritance properties to child connections.
- Enhanced NotificationPanelMessageWriter to handle pending messages more effectively.
- Updated MiscTools to support boolean conversion from strings and added standard value exclusivity.
- Added context menu options in ConfigWindow for applying inheritance properties to children and subtree.
- Introduced new menu items in ConnectionContextMenu for connecting selected connections and resetting subtree inheritance.
- Refined search box behavior in mrngSearchBox to simplify default text handling.
- Updated frmMain to improve window title handling with connection file paths.
- Added Config menu item in ViewMenu for toggling the configuration window visibility.
- Enhanced ConnectionTreeWindow to clear search prompt text on initialization and improve filtering logic.

triage.rationale: Mixed bag: new inheritance props (ExternalAddressProvider, RDP StartProgram, gateway token), notification detail, plus personal junk (.vscode, WorldOfFanXP.xml). Partly overlaps our upstream ports; cherry-pick only if users ask.
